name: Action Network
label: Action Network — advocacy CRM (OSDI REST v2)
description: Official Action Network REST API v2 (OSDI 1.1.1 / HAL+JSON) at https://actionnetwork.org/api/v2. Handler: OfficialApiNode. Partner API key header OSDI-API-Token. person.create uses the person signup helper (POST /people/). Advocacy PII — minimize fields. Customer owns the Action Network list. api_key is never logged or returned. Inbound webhooks: selecting the :listen operation (trigger.listen) via webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef) blocks the canvas INPUT port and compiles as a webhook-triggered Message Start (or binds to any Activity's MESSAGE Boundary Event). Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. Do not put secrets here. Set operation to override config.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation when non-blank. EXACT catalog verb. trigger.listen (:listen role) is configured on the node via webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef) for inbound webhooks (blocks the canvas INPUT port).

schema.label: person
schema.description: OSDI person envelope escape hatch for person.create/update, attendance.create, signature.create, personTag.add. Purpose fields (email, given_name, family_name, postal_code) merge into person via bodyMap. Example: {"phone_numbers":[{"number":"12025550100"}]}.

schema.label: given_name
schema.description: OSDI given_name on person.create/update, attendance.create, signature.create, personTag.add. Nested as person.given_name. Example: Ada.

schema.label: family_name
schema.description: OSDI family_name on person.create/update, attendance.create, signature.create, personTag.add. Nested as person.family_name. Example: Lovelace.

schema.label: email
schema.description: Primary email on person writes. Nested as person.email_addresses[0].address. Required by Action Network on person.create unless a phone is supplied inside person. Example: ada@example.com.

schema.label: postal_code
schema.description: Postal/ZIP on person writes. Nested as person.postal_addresses[0].postal_code. Example: 20009.

schema.label: background_request
schema.description: background_request=true to process person.create asynchronously.

schema.label: add_tags
schema.description: Tag names to add on person.create / attendance.create. Example: ["volunteer"].

schema.label: remove_tags
schema.description: Tag names to remove on person.create / attendance.create. Example: ["lapsed"].

schema.label: personId
schema.description: Person UUID without action_network: prefix.

schema.label: page
schema.description: 1-based page. per_page max 25.

schema.label: per_page
schema.description: Page size; API hard cap 25.

schema.label: filter
schema.description: oData filter (e.g. modified_date) when listing people.

schema.label: title
schema.description: Event or petition title for event.create and petition.create/update. Example: Town hall.

schema.label: start_date
schema.description: Event start ISO-8601 for event.create. Example: 2026-12-01T18:00:00Z.

schema.label: end_date
schema.description: Event end ISO-8601 for event.create.

schema.label: browser_url
schema.description: Public URL for event.create and petition.create/update.

schema.label: capacity
schema.description: Event capacity for event.create. Example: 100.

schema.label: origin_system
schema.description: Human-readable name of the system that created the record, sent on event.create and petition.create (Action Network requires it on POST). Free text; blank falls back to StudioQuack. Example: StudioQuack.

schema.label: eventId
schema.description: Event UUID.

schema.label: attendanceId
schema.description: Attendance UUID.

schema.label: description
schema.description: Petition description for petition.create/update.

schema.label: petitionId
schema.description: Petition UUID.

schema.label: comments
schema.description: Signature comments for signature.create.

schema.label: triggers
schema.description: Per-operation field `triggers`. Omit when unused. Never put secrets here.

schema.label: signatureId
schema.description: Signature UUID.

schema.label: name
schema.description: Tag name for tag.create (deduped by name). Example: volunteer.

schema.label: tagId
schema.description: Tag UUID.

schema.label: taggingId
schema.description: Tagging UUID for personTag.remove.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: status=ok, http_status, data (provider JSON). Inbound webhook events (:listen) emit normalized event data on output. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: status
schema.description: Exact 'ok' on HTTP 2xx.

schema.label: http_status
schema.description: Upstream status code.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Provider JSON body. Minimize retained PII.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is blank. EXACT: person.create | person.get | person.list | person.update | event.create | event.get | event.list | attendance.create | attendance.get | attendance.list | petition.create | petition.get | petition.list | petition.update | signature.create | signature.get | signature.list | signature.update | tag.create | tag.get | tag.list | personTag.add | personTag.remove | trigger.listen. Selecting trigger.listen (:listen role) reveals webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef), blocks the canvas INPUT port, and compiles as a webhook-triggered Message Start or Activity MESSAGE Boundary Event.

configurationParameters.label: Api Key
configurationParameters.description: Partner API key from Start Organizing → API & Sync. Header OSDI-API-Token. Scopes one list (personal or group). Never log.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout Seconds
configurationParameters.description: Per-request HTTP timeout. Positive number; <=0 → 25. Keep below the daemon invoke budget.

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Key
configurationParameters.description: Engine Webhook API Key binding ($webhookKeyRef) routing inbound HTTP webhooks to this node.
